headline: Indonesia Records State Budget Deficit Of Rp 379 Trillion By October
seoTitle: Indonesia State Budget Deficit Hits Rp 379 Trillion
metaDescription: The Indonesian government reported a budget deficit of Rp 379.3 trillion through October 2026, while subsidy spending reached Rp 415.8 trillion.
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia's state budget deficit reached Rp 379.3 trillion as of October 2026.
Government expenditure on subsidies and compensation totaled Rp 415.8 trillion for the same period.
Foreign capital outflows from emerging markets have reached approximately Rp 479.52 trillion as of September 2026.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Ministry of Finance reported that the national budget deficit stood at Rp 379.3 trillion by the end of October 2026. Data indicates that the government has realized subsidy and compensation expenditures amounting to Rp 415.8 trillion, representing 93% of the allocated budget. Concurrently, the financial environment has been influenced by global shifts, with the Minister of Finance noting that foreign capital outflows from emerging nations reached US$ 26.3 billion, equivalent to Rp 479.52 trillion, in September 2026. These developments highlight the ongoing fiscal management challenges faced by the Indonesian government as it navigates both domestic expenditure commitments and broader international economic pressures. The reported figures are part of the latest government transparency updates regarding the country's economic health and budgetary performance for the 2026 fiscal year.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high public interest in the state budget status, reflected by significant search volume and rapid dissemination across major news outlets.
